COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
WPSS No.128 of 2024
With
(Urgency Appl. No.02 of 2024)
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Vipul Sharma, learned counsel for the 
petitioners.
2. Mr. G.S. Negi, learned Addl. C.S.C. for the 
State/respondent nos.1, 2 & 4.
3. Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for 
respondent no.3.
4. Issue notice to respondent nos.5 to 8 
returnable within three weeks.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioners shall take 
steps to serve respondent nos.5 to 8 by registered 
post within a week.
6. Respondents may file the counter affidavit 
within a period of four weeks. Two weeks time 
thereafter is granted to the counsel for the counsel 
for the petitioners to file rejoinder affidavit.
7. The selection/appointment of respondent 
nos.5 to 8 on the post of Assistant Private Secretary 
in the Secretariat Department shall be subject to the 
decision of the writ petition.
8. It is made clear that without permission of 
this Court, respondents will not draw a seniority list. 
9. Urgency application stands disposed of 
accordingly. 
 
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 
 Vacation Judge
